content:
Miles Thornton  [root]  1708572234
Seeing elevated p95 latency + some 5xx for `chat-inference` us-east-1 starting ~10m ago. Paging SRE. Anyone aware of recent changes?

Rafael Mendes  1708572291
Ack. I’m looking at the incident dashboard now. Do we have deploy context for us-east? :eyes:

Sean Gallagher  1708572330
+1. If anyone has the deploy list handy please drop it here. Also please confirm if canary is running.

deploy-bot  1708572368
:rocket: Release event
Service: chat-inference
Region: us-east-1
Version: 2025.02.21.3
Rollout: canary 5%
Commit: 8f2c0d1
Pipeline: https://build.redwood.example/pipelines/chat-inference/129884
PR: https://github.com/redwoodinference/redwood/pull/18452

Jacob Stein  1708572402
I have the incident-bot deploy collector branch running in beta for #incidents. It should post the “recent deploys” bundle automatically but might not be enabled for this channel yet.

incident-bot  1708572440
Context bundle (beta) — Recent deploys (last 60m)
Service: chat-inference
Region: us-east-1
Window: 2025-02-21 23:40 → 2025-02-22 00:40 UTC

1) 2025.02.21.3 — canary (5%) — started 00:31 UTC
   • change: https://github.com/redwoodinference/redwood/pull/18452
   • pipeline: https://build.redwood.example/pipelines/chat-inference/129884
   • notes: “add recent-changes links to incident dashboards”

2) 2025.02.21.2 — stable — completed 23:58 UTC
   • change: https://github.com/redwoodinference/redwood/pull/18436
   • pipeline: https://build.redwood.example/pipelines/chat-inference/129770

Collector status: OK (0.8s)

Rafael Mendes  1708572489
Nice. This is exactly what we need. Correlation looks like canary start overlaps with the p95 jump.

Miles Thornton  1708572551
Question: should canary stand out more? In the thread at a glance it reads like “deploy happened” but not obvious it’s only 5%.

Paula Mendes  1708572620
Agree. For triage, “canary” should be visually loud because action differs (pause canary vs rollback stable). Maybe prefix with :test_tube: or “CANARY” tag.

Sean Gallagher  1708572687
+1. Also I want “canary %” as a first-class field. In incidents we keep asking “how big is the blast radius?”

Connor O'Brien  1708572734
We can emit canary metadata consistently but only if services use the new rollout controller fields. Some still publish just “phase=canary” without percent. We can default to “unknown%” rather than omit.

Priya Natarajan  1708572792
From platform side: canary vs stable matters for config/routing too (we sometimes shift traffic weights independently of deploy). If the deploy collector shows canary, we should probably also show current traffic weight if available.

Jacob Stein  1708572861
Noted. For the deploy collector output, I can:
- put CANARY entries at top regardless of timestamp (still within window)
- render as `CANARY 5%` bold
- add an extra line `traffic_weight: 5%` if the rollout event includes it

But we should be careful not to imply it’s the cause. Maybe add “Potentially relevant changes” section separately (heuristic).

Rafael Mendes  1708572938
While we debate formatting: mitigation-wise, can we pause the canary now? If it’s only 5% and we see 5xx, it’s a good candidate.

Sean Gallagher  1708572980
Yes. Miles can you pause canary for chat-inference us-east-1? If you don’t have permissions I can grab Connor.

Miles Thornton  1708573042
I can. Pausing canary now.

Miles Thornton  1708573136
Paused. Rollout controller shows traffic_weight back to 0%. Watching metrics.

Rafael Mendes  1708573275
p95 is already trending down. 5xx rate dropping too. Looks like canary build had an issue.

Paula Mendes  1708573360
This is the exact scenario where the bundle should scream “CANARY 5%” and “action: pause canary”. Otherwise folks over-rotate to full rollback.

Connor O'Brien  1708573499
One more nuance: we sometimes do canary in one AZ only (capacity reasons). Percent alone may mislead. Could add `scope: us-east-1a` when present.

Priya Natarajan  1708573622
+1. Also: if canary is limited to specific GPU pool (H100 vs A100), that’s super useful context. But I know that’s not in the release event today.

Jacob Stein  1708573791
Action items I’ll take from this thread for the collector output:
- Highlight canary rows differently (prefix tag + ordering)
- Always include canary % (or “unknown”) and scope if present (AZ/pool)
- Add a short hint line like “Suggested first check: pause canary (low blast radius)” but keep it clearly labeled as guidance, not diagnosis

Sean Gallagher  1708574010
Perfect. Please link this thread in ENG-2842 as validation. Also, the bot output looked good overall (timestamps, links). The canary differentiation is the missing piece.

incident-bot  1708575126
Feedback reminder (beta): react with :thumbsup: if this bundle was useful, :warning: if misleading/noisy, and drop specifics in-thread. (Logged to #eng-sre for triage.)
